metadata.required_game_version: v5.3.0.103 (Steam Demo) or v5.3.0.127 (Latest) + latest Visual C++ Redistributable (DVD v5.3.0.15 is incompatible with ReCap)
metadata.notes: Verified against both Steam Demo v5.3.0.103 (`DarksporeBin/Darkspore.exe` SHA-256 3c7248a4...73ee5b, ReCap compatible) and EA retail DVD v5.3.0.15 (`DarksporeBin/Darkspore.exe` SHA-256 3b499380...4dc2d8, marked incompatible with ReCap v0.7.2).

known_issues.summary: Official EA authentication and matchmaking servers were permanently shut down in March 2016
known_issues.details: Darkspore's client requires an online EA/SporeLabs endpoint at startup and login. Open-source Resurrection Capsule (ReCap v0.7.2) provides `RecapLauncher.exe`, `RecapHooks.dll`, and a local `recap_server.exe` to emulate the offline login/hero server locally.
known_issues.user_action_required: ReCap v0.7.2 requires the latest Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x86/x64) and officially supports Darkspore v5.3.0.103 (Steam Demo) or v5.3.0.127 (Latest); unpatched retail DVD v5.3.0.15 is marked incompatible by ReCap.

known_issues.summary: Modern GPUs default to unrecognized fallback settings and uncapped FPS causes Maxis engine instability
known_issues.details: Unrecognized GPUs in `Data/Config/ConfigManager.txt` fall back to `$gpuLevelMedium`, and uncapped high refresh rates can destabilize timers. Patching `ConfigManager.txt` promotes unrecognized cards to `$gpuLevelHigh` and adds `intProp frameLimitMS 17` (~60 FPS cap). An optional dgVoodoo 2 D3D9 wrapper further stabilizes rendering on Windows 10/11.

known_issues.summary: High-DPI scaling issues, fullscreen presentation drops, and high-core-count CPU stutter
known_issues.details: Applies per-user HKCU `HIGHDPIAWARE` and `DISABLEDXMAXIMIZEDWINDOWEDMODE` shims to `DarksporeBin/Darkspore.exe` and caps CPU affinity to 4 logical cores at AboveNormal priority on launch.

known_issues.summary: Prepare per-game `.ogsc_sandbox/saves` directory for portable backups
known_issues.details: Initializes `.ogsc_sandbox/saves` inside the Darkspore folder for keeping clean local backups without touching OS user profile folders.

fixes.title: Resurrection Capsule (ReCap v0.7.2) Offline Server & Launcher
fixes.description: Downloads SHA-256-verified open-source ReCap v0.7.2 (GPL-3.0) into `DarksporeBin/` (`RecapLauncher.exe`, `RecapHooks.dll`, local `Server/recap_server.exe`) and configures the launcher to start `DarksporeBin/RecapLauncher.exe`. Note: ReCap supports v5.3.0.103 / v5.3.0.127 and marks DVD v5.3.0.15 incompatible.

steps.name: Install Resurrection Capsule v0.7.2
steps.description: Downloads verified `resurrection-capsule-windows-x64.zip` and extracts `RecapLauncher.exe`, `RecapHooks.dll`, `RecapHooks.toml`, and `Server/` into `DarksporeBin/`.

fixes.title: Modern GPU High-Preset & 60 FPS Stability Cap (`ConfigManager.txt`)
fixes.description: Applies a verified bsdiff patch to `Data/Config/ConfigManager.txt` raising unrecognized modern GPU classification from `$gpuLevelMedium` to `$gpuLevelHigh` and appending `intProp frameLimitMS 17` (~60 FPS stability cap).

steps.name: Patch ConfigManager.txt (v5.3.0.103 High GPU + 60 FPS Cap)
steps.description: Verifies original v5.3.0.103 `Data/Config/ConfigManager.txt` hash and applies verified bsdiff patch (backed up cleanly to `.ogsc_backup`).

steps.name: Patch ConfigManager.txt (v5.3.0.15 High GPU + 60 FPS Cap)
steps.description: Verifies original v5.3.0.15 `Data/Config/ConfigManager.txt` hash and applies verified bsdiff patch (backed up cleanly to `.ogsc_backup`).

fixes.title: Windows 10/11 DPI, Fullscreen & 4-Core Affinity
fixes.description: Applies per-user HKCU AppCompatFlags (`HIGHDPIAWARE`, `DISABLEDXMAXIMIZEDWINDOWEDMODE`) to `DarksporeBin/Darkspore.exe` and caps CPU affinity to 4 logical cores at AboveNormal priority.

steps.name: Apply Windows High-DPI & Presentation Flags
steps.description: Writes non-destructive per-user HKCU AppCompatFlags for `DarksporeBin/Darkspore.exe`.

steps.name: Cap CPU Affinity to 4 Logical Cores
steps.description: Constrains process affinity to 4 logical cores with AboveNormal priority at launch.

fixes.title: dgVoodoo 2 Direct3D 9 -> Direct3D 11 Wrapper
fixes.description: Deploys dgVoodoo 2 x86 `d3d9.dll` and `dgVoodoo.conf` into `DarksporeBin/`. Recommended only if the native D3D9 renderer flickers or crashes on Alt-Tab.

fixes.title: Portable Save Directory (`.ogsc_sandbox/saves`)
fixes.description: Creates `.ogsc_sandbox/saves` inside the Darkspore folder for clean portable backup storage.

steps.name: Initialize Portable Save Sandbox
steps.description: Creates `.ogsc_sandbox/saves` without modifying OS profile directories.
